description: This source file defines the PdfSignature2 class within the PdfSharp library, specifically in the Pdf.Signatures namespace. The class represents a signature dictionary used when signing a PDF document, and it extends PdfDictionary. It includes constructors for creating instances with or without an existing PdfDocument.
